Malignancy originates in cutaneous sweat glands.
Benign smooth muscle tumor originates in the colon; visceral smooth muscle does not belong to the skeletal muscle axis.
Ovarian squamous epithelial neoplasm affects a reproductive organ; no endocrine dysfunction is specified.
Pus occupies the anterior eye chamber; the supplied hierarchy classifies this concept as infectious anterior uveitis, although hypopyon can also be sterile.
Nematode infection umbrella; tissue sites vary by organism and subtype, without a particular organ damaged in most patients across the group.
Mesenchymal soft-tissue sarcoma with fibroblastic differentiation, generally arising in deep soft tissues; no specific visceral origin is provided.
Carcinoma originates in the external ear, including its epithelial and ceruminous structures.
Self-limited humoral immunodeficiency; susceptibility to separately diagnosed infections does not establish additional organ damage.
Acute myeloid leukemia is a malignant disease of marrow and myeloid blood cells; this fusion does not establish other organ involvement.
Childhood epilepsy syndromes are disorders of cerebral function; no additional organ involvement is shared across this umbrella.
CD81 humoral immunodeficiency; nephritis and autoimmune thrombocytopenia occurred in 1/1 reported patient but are separately diagnosed autoimmune complications.

Congenital multicystic dysplasia leaves one kidney structurally abnormal and nonfunctional.

Congenital myopathy with bone fractures; respiratory insufficiency reflects muscle weakness. Obstructive sleep apnea in 3/3 is a separately diagnosed condition.
